messages:
maria (Design): quick copy/a11y check on the delete confirmation modal — current primary button reads 'Delete' and secondary 'Cancel'. SR reads primary as 'Confirm', which is ambiguous. :thinking_face:
lee (Product): saw a user test where they hesitated — 'Delete' didn't say what gets deleted. we should be explicit.
nina (Frontend): the modal component uses a generic aria-label prop set to 'Confirm'. i can change it but want agreed copy.
sam (a11y): recommendation: visible primary label should include the object (e.g., 'Delete model version') and aria-label must match. add aria-describedby pointing to the explanatory copy so SR users hear the consequence.
maria (Design): propose microcopy:
Heading: "Delete model version"
Body: "This action permanently removes the selected model version from the deployment. This cannot be undone."
Primary (danger): "Delete version"
Primary aria-label: "Delete model version"
Secondary: "Cancel"
lee (Product): short + clear. agree on aria-label parity.
nina (Frontend): i'll add aria-describedby id on the body and set button aria-label to match. will also ensure the danger styling uses a data attribute not just color.
sam (a11y): ensure role="dialog", focus lands on the dialog, and focus returns to the trigger after close. add an aria-live polite region for result messages. don't auto-focus the toast.
maria (Design): also add an undo in the toast: "Version deleted. Undo" with button text "Undo delete" and aria-label "Undo delete". make it a real button, focusable when tabbed to.
ux-bot: reminder: update Figma component 'Modal / Danger Confirm' and the copy doc (link in thread).
nina (Frontend): PR opened #4239 — implements copy, aria-describedby, focus return, and toast with undo. includes unit + cypress tests for focus return and live region text.
maria (Design): will review PR and update Figma. tagging @sam for final a11y sign-off. :sparkles:
sam (a11y): will run VoiceOver/NVDA checks after merge and verify live region announcements.
lee (Product): ship to canary after tests pass.
